verified: the applied package reconstructs the exact rebuilt BBX produced by the source workspace
equal-size deltas store sparse changed byte runs
variable-size deltas reconstruct through baseline copy + package data operations
deterministic ZIP output is independent of input mapping order

retail_localization_package.scope: externally supplied retail Xbox text.bin; source archive is not bundled
retail_localization_package.edit: one readable localization character changed while preserving file length

distribution_policy.equal_size_payload_policy: only bytes differing at their target offsets are stored
distribution_policy.length_changing_policy: copy/data delta stream; large whole-archive length changes are rejected above the conservative sequence-diff limit

boundaries: V1 does not automatically merge two packages that modify the same resource; conflicts require an explicit overwrite decision.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary edited values still requires emulator/hardware testing.
